title: ALLMTS: Automated LLM-based Medical Triage System
abstract: arXiv:2610.32469v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Telephone triage is a safety critical task: from a brief intake note, a nurse must decide whether a caller needs an ambulance, an emergency department, an appointment, or self care at home. Queried directly, large language models (LLMs) are unreliable: they over-escalate routine cases and cannot justify their recommendations against an auditable clinical standard. We present the Automated LLM-based Medical Triage System (ALLMTS), which grounds every disposition in the same commercially maintained telehealth guidelines nurses use. Rather than asking an LLM to triage, ALLMTS makes it execute the guideline: it selects the appropriate guideline and evaluates its triage assessment questions. The disposition follows deterministically from the first positive answer, using the same traversal rule a nurse follows. translated_title: ALLMTS：基于大语言模型的自动化医疗分诊系统
translated_abstract: 电话分诊是一项安全关键任务：根据一份简短的接诊记录，护士必须决定来电者是需要救护车、前往急诊科、预约门诊，还是在家自我护理。直接询问大语言模型（LLM）并不可靠：它们会过度升级常规病例，且无法依据可审计的临床标准来论证其建议的合理性。我们提出了基于大语言模型的自动化医疗分诊系统（ALLMTS），它将每一个分诊处置都建立在护士所使用的同类商业化维护的远程医疗指南之上。ALLMTS 并非直接让大语言模型进行分诊，而是让它执行指南：系统会选择合适的指南并评估其中的分诊评估问题。处置结果确定性地由第一个肯定答案得出，遵循与护士相同的遍历规则。我们在566个经过专家验证的合成场景上评估了ALLMTS，这些场景涵盖14种处置类型，旨在测试特定的指南问题（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了ALLMTS系统，不让大语言模型直接分诊，而是让它执行护士使用的商业化远程医疗分诊指南，根据第一个肯定答案确定性地得出分诊处置结果，从而提高了电话分诊的可靠性与可审计性。
en_tdlr: ALLMTS is an automated LLM-based medical triage system that, instead of asking an LLM to triage directly, makes it execute the commercially maintained telehealth guidelines nurses use, deterministically deriving dispositions from the first positive answer for reliable and auditable telephone triage.
